thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall in early active trade - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks fall in early active trade - MarketWatch
text: Shares of 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -4.60% components are trading lower in premarket trade Tuesday, with biggest decliners mixed among industrials, health care and retail sectors. The fact that all 30 Dow stocks were trading 2 1/2 hours before the open was also a sign of heightened investor anxiety, as Dow futures YMH8, -1.54% tumbled 390 points. Among the biggest decliners, shares of UnitedHealth Group Inc. UNH, -5.11% dropped 3.9%, United Technologies Corp. UTX, -5.48% shed 3.8%, Nike Inc. NKE, -4.21% lost 3.7%, American Express Co. AXP, -4.83% gave up 3.5% and Boeing Co. BA, -5.74% fell 3.4%. In retail, Home Depot Inc.'s stock HD, -5.60% lost 2.0% and WalMart Inc. WMT, -4.20% shares slid 2.0%. In technology, Microsoft Corp. shares MSFT, -4.12% declined 2.1% and Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, -2.50% was down 0.8%.
